output.explanation: Expanded workspace because its draft/session lifetimes and mounted surfaces hide substantial internal composition. The central diagram retains App, shared client services and page-owned coordination; two peripherals deepen CanvasWorkspace ownership and mounted rendering. Domain and backend remain unchanged as separate semantic and service-boundary maps. Verified against the pinned checkout, including App/services, MappingPage, CanvasWorkspace, CanvasSession, WorkspacePersistence, editor runtimes, controller/history and backend wiring. Corrected SourceWindowPanel to a sibling of MappingEditorCanvas, distinguished borrowed sessions and editor drivers from ownership, and replaced the unconditional BOTH-controller transfer claim with participating controllers plus the projection-copy child-only navigation exception. All existing edges are retained, with moved endpoints redirected; added ownership, borrowing and notification links. New diagrams fit below workspace without moving existing diagrams.
